ITEM #9513
Type: issue

Title: deform_conv2d kernels are launched on the default CUDA stream
Author: user-1
Created: 2026-06-13
Labels: (none)
Body:
### 🐛 Describe the bug

The `deform_conv2d` kernels are launched on the default CUDA stream, not the current pytorch stream

https://github.com/pytorch/vision/blob/65eb7b9e26750ae59e2748d340d8b0ff58b28bec/torchvision/csrc/ops/cuda/deform_conv2d_kernel.cu#L253

pytorch kernels should launch on the stream returned by `at::cuda::getCurrentCUDAStream();`, e.g.
https://github.com/pytorch/vision/blob/65eb7b9e26750ae59e2748d340d8b0ff58b28bec/torchvision/csrc/ops/cuda/roi_pool_kernel.cu#L158

### Versions

It's on the current main branch
